claims.statement: For every m>=1 and fixed nonzero finite-dimensional algebraic O(m,C) representation W, its ordinary tensor multiplicity series is D-finite and algebraic iff m<=3.
claims.evidenceType: written proof using named classical inputs

claims.statement: Reduced symmetric determinantal symmetric-sequence Hilbert series are algebraic iff the allowed rank is at most three; all finite ranks are D-finite.
The scalar coefficient asymptotic including its exact constant is Regev 1981 Theorem 3.3 combined with F.4.5.1.
Virtual differences are excluded: in dimension four the trivial minus determinant series is algebraic.
claims.evidenceType: corollary of the symmetric/antisymmetric swap calculation
